anuncio.Dica: Who sees the messages for opened locks and failed attempts.

mostrarCD.Dica: Shown on the thieves' tools check button.

cliquePorta.Nome: Clicking a locked door opens the lock
cliquePorta.Dica: When a player clicks the icon of a locked door that has a lock, the window to use a key or pick the lock opens.

entrarRegiao.Nome: Entering a locked region opens the lock
entrarRegiao.Dica: When the player's token stops inside a locked region (a portal, for example), the lock window appears.

botaoHUD.Dica: Shows the key button on the token HUD, which lists the locks in reach.

ferramentasContam.Nome: Thieves' tools count as a lockpick
ferramentasContam.Dica: Turn off so only the items you marked as lockpicks can pick locks.

gazuaEquipada.Dica: The character can only pick locks with a lockpick equipped on the sheet (Inventory → equip).

testeDadosEmCena.Nome: Thieves' tools check through Dados em Cena
testeDadosEmCena.Dica: With the Dados em Cena module active, the lockpicking check is requested through it: on the animated screen or the simple screen (chat card). Without the module, the check is rolled from the sheet.

quebraGazua.Dica: On a failure the lockpick breaks and one unit leaves the inventory (e.g. 20 lockpicks become 19). Choose which failures do this.

Aviso.SemMestre: The lock needs a GM connected.
Aviso.Longe: You are too far from that lock.
Aviso.NaoServe: The key "{chave}" does not fit this lock.
Aviso.SemFechadura: This no longer has a lock.
Aviso.ChaveSumiu: The character no longer has that key.
Aviso.MestraGasta: The key "{chave}" wore out and broke after this use.
Aviso.SoChave: This lock only opens with its key.
Aviso.SemTentativas: You can no longer try to pick this lock.
Aviso.ErroMacro: The lock's macro failed. Check the console (F12).
Aviso.Erro: Something went wrong with the lock. Check the GM's console (F12).
Aviso.ErroJogo: The minigame did not open. Check the console (F12) and send me the error.
Aviso.GazuaDesgastou: The lockpick "{nome}" bent, but can take {n} more failure(s).
Aviso.SemRolagem: The GM could not find your Thieves' Tools roll. Try again.
Aviso.TokenNaoVinculado: "{item}" was given to {ator}'s token, which is not linked to the sheet. Such items stay only on this token and disappear from the character sheet (for example, when the player logs in again). Turn on "Link Actor Data" for the character's token.

Janela.Esgotou: You have tried too many times. This lock will not give way for you.
Janela.Equipe: Equip the lockpick ("{nome}") on the sheet to pick locks: Inventory → equip button.
Janela.AguardandoTeste: Roll the thieves' tools check on the roll screen.
Janela.TesteSemResposta: The check was not rolled in time. Try again.
Janela.ComoAbrir: How to open with a lockpick
Janela.ComoAbrir1: Have a lockpick equipped on your sheet (Inventory → equip).
Janela.ComoAbrir2: Stand next to the lock with your token selected.
Janela.ComoAbrir3: Choose Simple lockpick (just the thieves' tools check) or Lockpick minigame.
Janela.ComoAbrir4: In the minigame, the check against the DC comes first (if the GM turned it on): on a success the arcane ward appears and you have some time to undo it.

Item.BonusDica: Added to the lockpicking check and gives +2 s in the minigame per point.
Item.UsosDica: How many failures each unit takes before breaking (1 = breaks on the first failure). When it breaks, one unit leaves the inventory. When it breaks (checks, minigames or both) is set in the module settings.
Item.NaoEquipa: This kind of item cannot be equipped, and "The lockpick must be equipped" is on: it will never work as a lockpick. Use a Tool or Equipment item.
Item.QuantidadeDica: How many lockpicks the character has. They show in the sheet's "Uses" column (e.g. 20/20) and each one that breaks spends a use. When the uses run out, the item leaves the inventory.
Item.QuantidadeDicaSemUsos: This kind of item has no "Uses" on the sheet, so the lockpicks are kept in the item's quantity. Use a Tool to see them in the "Uses" column.

Config.NivelDica: Makes the minigame harder (characters with a high bonus face an easier version) and limits which master keys open it.
Config.SegredosDica: Comma-separated code words. Any key holding one of these secrets opens this lock. Reuse a secret on several locks so one key opens them all.
Config.MestraDica: Uncheck for special locks (a magic seal, for example) that only open with the right key.
Config.CriarChave: Create a key for this lock
Config.ChaveCriada: Item "{nome}" created in the Items tab.
Config.LembreSalvar: Remember to save the lock so the secret takes effect.
Config.SemChave: How to open without the key
Config.CDDica: Check difficulty. A high bonus compared to the DC makes the minigame easier.
Config.TentativasDica: How many failures each character may have before giving up on this lock. 0 = unlimited.
Config.AlcanceDica: Maximum distance from the token to the lock.
Config.AbrirPortaDica: Unchecked: the door only unlocks and the player opens it.
Config.VisibilidadeDica: E.g. hide the closed-chest tile or reveal the open-chest tile.
Config.PermissaoDicaToken: Permission on the chest's actor for whoever opened it (Item Piles chests just unlock).
Config.PermissaoDicaDiario: Permission on the journal for whoever opened it. Leave the journal without player permission: the key is what grants it.
Config.ParaTodosDica: Permissions and revealed journals apply to everyone, not just whoever opened it.
Config.GatilhoDica: While locked, this object's trigger stays disabled.
Config.JournalDica: A journal or page shown to whoever unlocked it (drag it from the sidebar).
Config.MacroDica: Runs on the GM. Receives fechadura (the lock document), actor and token.
Config.TrancadaDica: Turn off to keep the lock configured but open.

ModosDica.chave: Nobody picks it. Only the right key (or a master key) opens it.
ModosDica.teste: One thieves' tools check against the DC. Quick.
ModosDica.minigame: The lock has an arcane ward: the player undoes it in a minigame, against the clock.
ModosDica.ambos: Both options appear: check or minigame.

Config.FerramentasDica: Without a lockpick item in the inventory, the character cannot try. Any item can become a lockpick via the sheet header menu.
Config.MensagemExemplo: e.g. The door creaks and a musty smell escapes…
Config.SoChaveRemoto: Journals only open with a key: give a key the same secret as this lock.
Config.JogoAleatorioDica: Picks one of the minigames at random on each attempt.
Config.TempoDica: Seconds to finish the minigame. 0 = no limit.
Config.TesteAntes: Beat the DC to use the lockpick
Config.TesteAntesDica: Before the minigame, roll thieves' tools against the DC. On a failure there is no minigame; each point above the DC gives +2 s.
Config.SoltarChave: Drag any item here (from the Items tab or a character's inventory) to make it this lock's key.
Config.ImporteAntes: Compendium items cannot be changed: import the item first.
Config.ViraChave: "{nome}" is now a key for this lock. Save the lock.
Config.NenhumaChave: No item opens this lock yet.
Config.Desvincular: Stop opening this lock (the item still exists)
Config.ExcluirPergunta: Delete {nome} for good? This removes the item from the world (or from the character's inventory) and cannot be undone.

Chave.SegredosDica: Comma-separated. The key opens any lock holding one of these secrets.
Chave.UsosMaxDica: After this many uses it wears out and disappears. 0 = unlimited.
Chave.Remover: Make it a regular item again
Chave.Removida: The item is a regular item again.

TipoDica.comum: Opens locks with the same secret and leaves the inventory when used.
TipoDica.mestra: Not consumed, and opens locks even without the secret, within the limits below.
TipoDica.gazua: Used to pick locks. May give a bonus and break after a few failures.

Painel.SemFechaduras: No locks on this map or in journals.
Painel.ComoCriar: To create one: open the configuration of a door, token, tile, region, note or journal and use the header menu → Lock.
Painel.Testar: Open as a player (with the selected token)
Painel.SemChaves: No keys in the Items tab.

Jogo.Abriu: The enchantment unravels. The lock opened!
Jogo.Quebrou: Your concentration broke. The ward held.

discos.Resumo: Turn the rings until each one's glowing rune sits under the sigil.
discos.Comeco: Bring each ring's glowing rune under the sigil at the top.
discos.Passo1: Click a ring to turn it right; right-click (or Shift) turns it left.
discos.Passo2: Some rings are bound by magic and drag their neighbour along. Hover to see which are linked.
discos.Passo3: With every rune under the sigil, the enchantment unravels. Keyboard: ↑ ↓ picks a ring, ← → turns it.

runas.Resumo: The seal lights a sequence of runes; touch them in the same order.
runas.Comeco: Get ready: the seal will show the sequence.
runas.Passo1: Watch the order in which the runes light up.
runas.Passo2: Then touch the runes in the same order (or use keys 1 to 8).
runas.Passo3: A mistake shakes your concentration and the seal shows the sequence again. At high levels, the order is reversed.
runas.Repita: Your turn: touch the runes in the same order.
runas.RepitaInvertido: Your turn: touch the runes in reverse order.
runas.Errou: Wrong rune! The seal sparks back.

labirinto.Resumo: Guide a spark through the ward's invisible lines to its core.
labirinto.Comeco: The ward's lines are invisible: guide the spark to the core, on the right.
labirinto.Passo1: Move the spark with the arrows (or W A S D, or the buttons).
labirinto.Passo2: The barriers are invisible: each shock reveals one and shakes your concentration.
labirinto.Passo3: Reach the core on the right edge and push right to undo the ward.
labirinto.Perto: The core pulses beside you. Push right!

sigilo.Resumo: Trace every line of the sigil without going over any line twice.
sigilo.Comeco: Pick a rune to start tracing the sigil.
sigilo.Passo1: Click a rune to start, then click runes linked to it to trace each line.
sigilo.Passo2: Each line can only be traced once. Moving where there is no line, or repeating one, shakes your concentration.
sigilo.Passo3: Tip: if a rune has an odd number of lines, start there. Stuck? The trace fades and you start over.
sigilo.Comecou: Now follow the lines without repeating any.
sigilo.SemLinha: There is no line between those runes!
sigilo.Preso: No way out! The trace fades.

cristais.Resumo: Touching a crystal flips it and its neighbours; light them all.
cristais.Passo1: Touching a crystal turns it and the crystals above, below and beside it on or off.
cristais.Passo2: Get them all lit at the same time so the ward falls into harmony and opens.
cristais.Passo3: Tip: touching the same crystal twice undoes it.

canalizar.Resumo: Hold to raise the mana and keep it inside the runic band until the seal fills.
canalizar.Comeco: Keep the mana inside the runic band.
canalizar.Passo1: Hold the click (or Space) to raise the mana; let go and it falls.
canalizar.Passo2: The runic band moves. With the mana inside it, the seal fills; outside, it drains.
canalizar.Passo3: Fill the seal to 100% before time runs out.

Ajustes.DicaMenu: Settings for each minigame: whether it is in the draw, its own time, difficulty and options.
Ajustes.Explicacao: These settings apply to every lock. A lock that picks a specific minigame uses it even if it is out of the draw.

Dica.ativo: Off: this game never shows up in Surprise.
Dica.ajuste: Added to the lock's level for this game only (−3 easier, +3 harder).
Dica.ligacoes: On: some rings turn along with their neighbour.
Dica.inverterDesde: 0 = never asks for the reverse order.
Dica.mostrarRastro: Off: not even the path already taken shows: harder.
Dica.maxRunas: From 5 to 10 runes in the sigil.
Dica.dicaImpar: Marks the runes with an odd number of lines (start at one of them).
Dica.velocidade: 1 = normal; 2 = the band moves twice as fast.
